On Monday 25 May 2026, the day after the body of a 12-year-old boy who had been strangled (the boy was found with a wet towel tightly wrapped around his neck) was discovered on the banks of the Vilaine in Rennes (France), detectives from the Judicial Police, assisted by a team of divers who searched the river, were looking for clues to shed light on the circumstances of this tragedy.
Lundi 25 mai 2026, au lendemain de la decouverte du corps d un enfant de 12 ans tue par etranglement (le garcon a ete retrouve avec une serviette mouillee fortement serree autour du cou) sur les bords de la Vilaine a Rennes (France), les enqueteurs de la Police Judiciaire epaules par une equipe de plongeurs qui ont sonde la riviere etaient a la recherche d indices afin d eclaircir les circonstances de ce drame.
